name: kleidos-cla-worker
description: The Kleidos CLA bot and signing site (Cloudflare Worker behind cla.kleidos.dev)

scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage && npm run test:conditions && npm run test:ratchet
scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-agreement.mjs && git diff --quiet HEAD && git verify-commit HEAD && git fetch --quiet origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main && wrangler deploy --var BUILD_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
scripts.test:scripts: cd .. && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='scripts/*.ts' --test-coverage-include='worker/scripts/*.mjs' --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 scripts/test/*.test.ts && node tests/tools/node/selftest.mjs && node tests/tools/node/scripts-mcdc.mjs coverage/scripts-mcdc.json scripts/test/*.test.ts && python3 tests/tools/ratchet.py check scripts --conditions coverage/scripts-mcdc.json
scripts.test:scripts-mutation: cd .. && node tests/tools/node/scripts-mut.mjs --out coverage/scripts-mutation.json --workers 2 --timeout 60 && python3 tests/tools/ratchet.py check scripts --mutants coverage/scripts-mutation.json
